name: Model Context Protocol (MCP) Server Kit (stdio + SSE)
note: Each task runs a real vitest command with no mocks of the code under test: the real McpServer is driven through the SDK's in-memory transport, and the real Express SSE app is bound to an ephemeral localhost port and called with fetch. Sandbox tests use a temp directory. No database or external service is involved. The stdio transport is not exercised end to end. Token figures are not recorded here; evals/runner.py measures context cost from the kit files.

eval_tasks.title: Tools and MCP protocol
eval_tasks.instruction: Tools must be registered with typed Zod inputs and behave correctly through the MCP protocol.
assertions: tools/list advertises three tools with object input schemas
wrong types and enum values are rejected by Zod
tool errors are structured and carry no internals
eval_tasks.verify: cd starter && npx vitest run tests/mcp-tools.test.ts tests/protocol.test.ts

eval_tasks.title: Filesystem sandbox, size cap and error sanitization
eval_tasks.instruction: read_secure_file must stay inside the sandbox root, cap output, and expose only structured error codes.
assertions: SEC-03: ../ traversal, prefix-sibling directory, absolute path and symlink escape are all rejected
SEC-08: output is capped at MAX_READ_BYTES and large files are not fully loaded
SEC-12: raw fs errors and requested paths are masked
SEC-05: no child_process, eval or Function in src
SEC-02: Dockerfile runtime stage is non-root
eval_tasks.verify: cd starter && npx vitest run tests/security-sandbox.test.ts

eval_tasks.title: SSE transport hardening and JSON-RPC conformance
eval_tasks.instruction: The SSE transport must require a bearer token, restrict CORS, cap bodies, rate limit, isolate sessions and speak JSON-RPC 2.0.
assertions: SEC-07: missing or wrong bearer token gets 401; app refuses to start without a key
SEC-09: only allowlisted origins are echoed, never *
SEC-06: initialize and tools/list return jsonrpc 2.0 responses with matching ids; unknown method returns -32601; non-JSON-RPC body is 400
SEC-10: requests beyond the window limit get 429
responses are routed to the originating session only
eval_tasks.verify: cd starter && npx vitest run tests/sse-http.test.ts

eval_tasks.title: Full suite green and TypeScript builds
eval_tasks.instruction: The complete suite must pass and the starter must type-check cleanly.
eval_tasks.verify: cd starter && npx vitest run && npx tsc --noEmit -p .
